env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# Derive module path from import comment.
cd $WORK/x
exists x.go
bolero mod init
stderr 'module x'

# Import comment works even with CRLF line endings.
rm go.mod
replace '\n' '\r\n' x.go
bolero mod init
stderr 'module x'

# Derive module path from location inside BOLERO_PATH.
# 'bolero mod init' should succeed if modules are not explicitly disabled.
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/x/y
bolero mod init
stderr 'module example.com/x/y$'
rm go.mod

# bolero mod init rejects a zero-length go.mod file
cp $devnull go.mod # can't use touch to create it because Windows
! bolero mod init
stderr 'go.mod already exists'

# Empty directory outside BOLERO_PATH fails.
mkdir $WORK/empty
cd $WORK/empty
! bolero mod init
stderr 'cannot determine module path for source directory'
rm go.mod

# Empty directory inside BOLERO_PATH/src uses location inside BOLERO_PATH.
mkdir $BOLERO_PATH/src/empty
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/empty
bolero mod init
stderr 'empty'
rm go.mod

# In Plan 9, directories are automatically created in /n.
# For example, /n/go.mod always exist, but it's a directory.
# Test that we ignore directories when trying to find go.mod.
cd $WORK/gomoddir
! bolero list .
stderr '^bolero: go.mod file not found in current directory or any parent directory; see ''bolero help modules''$'

[!symlink] stop

# gplink1/src/empty where gopathlink -> BOLERO_PATH
symlink $WORK/gopathlink -> gopath
cd $WORK/gopathlink/src/empty
bolero mod init
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_PATH/src/link where link -> out of BOLERO_PATH
symlink $BOLERO_PATH/src/link -> $WORK/empty
cd $WORK/empty
! bolero mod init
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/link
bolero mod init
stderr link
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_PATH/src/empty where BOLERO_PATH itself is a symlink
env BOLERO_PATH=$WORK/gopathlink
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/empty
bolero mod init
rm go.mod
cd $WORK/gopath/src/empty
bolero mod init
rm go.mod

# BOLERO_PATH/src/link where BOLERO_PATH and link are both symlinks
cd $BOLERO_PATH/src/link
bolero mod init
stderr link
rm go.mod

# Too hard: doesn't match unevaluated nor completely evaluated. (Only partially evaluated.)
# Whether this works depends on which OS we are running on.
# cd $WORK/gopath/src/link
# ! bolero mod init

-- $WORK/x/x.go --
package x // import "x"

-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/x/y/y.go --
package y
-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/x/y/z/z.go --
package z
-- $BOLERO_PATH/src/example.com/x/y/z/Godeps/Godeps.json --
{"ImportPath": "unexpected.com/z"}

-- $WORK/gomoddir/go.mod/README.txt --
../go.mod is a directory, not a file.
-- $WORK/gomoddir/p.go --
package p
